intended_use: Membrane stress calculation example; pressure acceptance is not evaluated.

source.title: Pressure Vessels
source.locator: Problems, Problem 1, printed page 9; equations (2) and (3), printed page 3
source.retention: Public source is referenced; no source publication is copied.

conversions.source_title: NIST Special Publication 811, Guide for the Use of the International System of Units, 2008 edition
conversions.locator: Appendix B.8, inch and pound-force per square inch entries; section 4.3, SI prefixes

assumptions.basis: The unqualified source diameter is interpreted as the internal diameter because the calculation interface requires the inner radius.
assumptions.consequence: Confirm the diameter convention before applying the stresses to a physical component.
